egress.terms: 100 GB/month CDN bandwidth included per project, hard cap on Free (no overage purchase). Assets served from cdn.sanity.io with on-the-fly transforms.

record.tooling: sanity CLI (`sanity dataset create`, `sanity assets upload`), @sanity/client HTTP API; assets land on cdn.sanity.io with stable public URLs
record.chaining: Accounts have no published maximum limit on project count. Each project provides 2 datasets with 100 GB asset storage (200 GB total per project). Additional accounts can be created via standard third-party login providers.
record.limits_note: Free tier allows 2 datasets and 10,000 documents per project, with 20 user seats. Hard limits enforce 100 GB asset storage and 100 GB monthly bandwidth, blocking asset API access once quota is reached.
record.reliability_note: Free projects are hard-capped, not throttled: at 100 GB bandwidth the CDN returns errors until the calendar month resets. Asset URLs are public and permanent; no expiry observed.
